_readme: S727 (lever), the gap census's reader_page_assignment lever (census of 2026-11-25 01:39Z): 4 programs of North Orange Continuing Education whose filed record places none of the state's listed courses. Free page read 45562584495 read the Business, English as a Second Language and Basic Skills area pages and the award pages they link; each award page prints its Program number ('Program #3P46252' for ESL for Office Assistants 46252). These are filed as named gaps and are never sent to a paid read. Their filed records stay as filed (the load skips a record that places none). No model call, no Supabase write. Each is the college's to settle in COCI or its catalog.

reasons.noncredit_not_in_catalog: A noncredit program the 2026-27 catalog prints under no heading of its own: its area's list of noncredit certificates does not name it.
reasons.successor_printed: The 2026-27 catalog prints no page for the program: the one page under its title prints another program's number, a program the state's file lists on its own and the harvest reads from that page.

programs.title: Business Information Worker I
programs.note: The Business area page links Bookkeeping, Classroom Essentials for Program Success, Customer Relations, Entrepreneurship, Human Resource Assistant, Management Program and Office Assistant (Introduction, Advanced), and no Business Information Worker.

programs.title: ESL for Personal Care Aides
programs.note: The English as a Second Language area page links 46 award pages, none whose title names personal care; the filed record was read from ESL for Office Assistants' page (Program #3P46252).

programs.title: ESL Specialty Courses
programs.note: The English as a Second Language area page links two pages under the title, 'ESL Specialty Courses, Beginning' (Program #3P44168) and 'ESL Specialty Courses, Intermediate to Advanced' (Program #3P44169); the harvest reads 44168 and 44169 from those pages. No page prints 39325.

programs.title: GED/HiSET Test Preparation
programs.note: The Basic Skills area page links one page under the title, 'GED/HiSET Test Preparation' (ged-test-preparation/), which prints 'Program Code: 3P45936'; the harvest reads 45936 from that page. No page prints 39625.
